name: A_flare
prompt: High-fidelity iOS app UI, a full-screen screenshot of an iPhone 16 Pro in portrait, edge to edge, no device frame, no hands. Designed by a top product designer, Airbnb and Apple Maps level polish. App: ChinaPal, a travel planner that turns the Instagram reels you saved into a trip. Design system: warm ivory background #FAF7F2, ink text #141414, coral accent #FF5A36 used sparingly, secondary grey #8A8580; SF Pro typography with a clear hierarchy (34 pt bold large title, 17 pt semibold, 13 pt secondary); 8 pt grid; generous whitespace; 20 pt rounded cards with very soft shadows; thin SF Symbols icons; real, beautiful, colour-consistent photography of Shanghai. Every word spelled exactly as written, sharp and legible. Screen: the Day 1 itinerary. Top to bottom: iOS status bar '9:41'. Navigation row with a back chevron, small centred label 'Shanghai', share icon. Large title 'Your Shanghai trip', subtitle '3 days · 10 places · from 10 reels you saved'. A small overlapping stack of 5 round reel thumbnails with the label '10 saved reels'. A full-width rounded map card: elegant muted map of central Shanghai, the Huangpu river in soft blue, a coral route line through numbered coral pins 1 to 5. A segmented control: 'Day 1 · Sat' (selected), 'Day 2 · Sun', 'Day 3 · Mon'. Section header 'French Concession & the Bund' with '5 stops · 4.1 km' on the right. A timeline of stop cards, each with a tall 3:4 reel thumbnail with a small play icon on the left and on the right: the time in small coral caps, the place name, a coral caption with an Instagram reel icon 'From @travel.creator's reel', and a one-line tip in grey. Stops: '10:00' 'Wukang Mansion' tip 'Go before 10 to beat the crowds'; thin connector with a walking icon '12 min walk'; '11:00' 'Anfu Road' tip 'Coffee under the plane trees'; connector '8 min walk'; '12:30' 'Soup dumpling spot' tip 'Order the crab xiaolongbao'; connector 'Metro line 10 · 20 min'; '14:30' 'Cat café' tip 'Closed Tuesdays'. At the bottom a floating frosted-glass tab bar with icons 'Trip', 'Map', 'Saved', 'Profile', and above it a floating coral pill button 'Start Day 1'.
